title: Dual coefficient norm on n-vectors: continuous, nonnegative, dominating, and attained on the unit covector ball
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ there is a function N from n-vectors to ℝ with the following properties. Here n-vectors are the continuous linear functionals ζ on the space Λⁿ(ℝ^P) of n-covectors (MultiVector P n, with the operator-norm topology), and |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α = (Σ_{I strictly increasing} α(e_{I(1)},…,e_{I(n)})²)^{1/2} with (e_i) the standard basis of ℝ^P. (i) N is continuous; (ii) N(ζ) ≥ 0 for every ζ; (iii) |ζ(α)| ≤ N(ζ)·|α| for every n-vector ζ and every n-covector α; (iv) for every n-vector ζ there is an n-covector β with |β| ≤ 1 and ζ(β) = N(ζ).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), ∃ N : MultiVector P n → ℝ, Continuous N ∧ (∀ ζ : MultiVector P n, 0 ≤ N ζ) ∧ (∀ (ζ : MultiVector P n) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ζ α| ≤ N ζ * covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ (∀ ζ : MultiVector P n, ∃ β : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm β ≤ 1 ∧ ζ β = N ζ)
